summary: Tested live public API/UI flows, responsive navigation, AI assistant, WhatsApp status, and unauthenticated admin protection. Core booking and seeded availability pass; reservation modification allows an occupied time, and the public UI has no lookup/modify/cancel flow.

critical.issue: A confirmed reservation at 22:00 can be patched to 21:00 when its table is already occupied at 21:00; endpoint returns 200 instead of 409 and does not re-check availability or reservation locks.

ui_bugs.issue: The visible authentication gate has no data-testid, violating the required testability contract; the first UI assertion could only be made through the .admin-gate class.

integration_issues.issue: No public lookup, modify, or cancel UI is rendered in App.js despite backend endpoints existing; customers cannot use these required features from the website.

action_items: Make PATCH reservation changes use the same availability and atomic lock checks as creation, returning 409 for occupied targets.
Add customer-facing lookup, modify, and cancel screens wired to the existing APIs.
Add data-testid=admin-gate to the unauthenticated admin gate (and keep unique test IDs on all critical states).
critical_code_review_comments: update_reservation writes date/start_time/guests directly without checking busy_tables or changing reservation_locks, allowing overlapping reservations.
The admin API checks for any valid session but does not enforce an admin role; confirm that every Google-authenticated session is intentionally allowed to view guest data.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (public booking, AI, mobile, and auth gate behavior passed; authenticated admin dashboard not testable without credentials)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST API/UI reservations on future dates and cancelled them after tests; no permanent seed data intentionally added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public booking flow, seeded availability, lookup/cancel API, AI reply, mocked WhatsApp status, desktop/mobile overflow, and unauthenticated admin gate were tested. Google OAuth callback and authenticated admin stats/floor plan remain untested because /app/memory/test_credentials.md contains no identities or session credentials.
rca of the issue: PATCH /api/reservations/{id} merges requested fields into the current document and persists them without invoking available_for, checking the target table's busy interval, or updating the unique reservation_locks collection. Reproduce by creating one reservation at 21:00 and another at 22:00, then PATCH the latter with start_time=21:00; it returns 200 and overlaps the first booking.
